parsed.study_design: Descriptive sector case study using administrative time-series data (1980–1988)
parsed.population_and_sample: Population within the Provincial Waterworks Authority service area outside metropolitan Bangkok; 4.884 million people and approximately 515,180 connections in 1988, with annual administrative data for 1980–1988.
parsed.exposure: Provincial Waterworks Authority governance and service-expansion arrangements, including national coverage targets, public investment and subsidies, tariff and cost-recovery policy, institutional responsibilities, staffing, and external financing.
parsed.outcome: Piped-water connections and population coverage, including an increase from 45.60% coverage in 1980 to 58.01% in 1988, alongside production capacity and service-performance indicators.
parsed.rationale: The “Status and Service Coverage” section (p. 225) reports longitudinal administrative evidence on population served, connections, and coverage in PWA service areas, with annual figures presented in Table 1 (p. 226). The paper also examines institutional and administrative determinants of expansion—particularly government targets, PWA responsibilities, subsidies, tariffs, staffing, and investment constraints—in the “Sector Institutions,” “Financing, Cost Recovery and Tariff,” and “Future Program” sections (pp. 224–227).
